symbols.name: DevAppInstanceContext
symbols.summary: The immutable development instance context resolved once per host startup.
symbols.remarks: An inactive context has BridgingIT.DevKit.Common.DevAppInstanceContext.IsActive set to false, reports BridgingIT.DevKit.Common.DevAppInstanceContext.InactiveReason and never carries a worktree ID, slot, URL or path. Use BridgingIT.DevKit.Common.DevAppInstanceContext.ToStatus for the sanitized projection. The full context contains local paths and managed values and is never sent to a browser.

symbols.name: Inactive(string, string)
symbols.summary: Creates an inactive context.

symbols.name: Fallback(DevAppInstanceException, string)
symbols.summary: Creates the inactive context of a host that fell back to its configured defaults after isolation failed. The context carries one warning log step that names the failure and the recovery action.
